project.name: escalation-chain
project.description: A greenfield Python package whose last story can only complete through a two-hop cross-story escalation: its change exposes a defect in the scaffold's normaliser through the registry's test.

scaffold.description: Package skeleton, the shared normaliser, the first greeting

core.description: The registry and the greeting that uses the shared normaliser

stories.title: Scaffold the esc package with its shared name normaliser
stories.description: Create requirements.txt declaring pytest, pytest.ini with pythonpath = src, a src/esc package, src/esc/normalize.py exporting normalize(name: str) -> str that strips surrounding whitespace, src/esc/greet.py exporting greet(name: str) -> str returning 'hello ' followed by the name stripped and lowercased, and tests/test_normalize.py asserting normalize strips whitespace.
acceptanceCriteria: requirements.txt lists pytest and pytest.ini sets pythonpath = src
normalize('  Bob  ') returns a value with no surrounding whitespace
Running python -m pytest at the codeline root exits 0

stories.title: Add the greeting registry with its tests
stories.description: Add src/esc/registry.py exporting register(greeting: str) -> str that returns the key a greeting is registered under (the greeting itself), and tests/test_registry.py asserting that register(greet(' Bob ')) == 'hello bob'.
acceptanceCriteria: Running python -m pytest at the codeline root exits 0

stories.title: Make the greeting use the shared name normaliser
stories.description: Change src/esc/greet.py so greet(name) returns 'hello ' followed by normalize(name) from src/esc/normalize.py, with no normalisation of its own, and add tests/test_greet.py asserting greet('bob') == 'hello bob'. Every existing test must stay green.
acceptanceCriteria: greet uses normalize from esc.normalize and normalises nothing itself
Running python -m pytest at the codeline root exits 0
